english.title: Driver of a motor vehicle fail to give name / address / produce insurance / test cert after road accident / offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on a road namely, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), on being so required by a constable, failed to give your name and address and to produce for examination the relevant certificate of insurance under Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and a test certificate issued in respect of the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) ofthe Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drive a motor vehicle / suspected of being the driver of a motor vehicle on a road
at time of accident / committing an offence in relation to motor vehicle
fail to give to constable your name and address and produce
relevant cert of insurance/security and test certificate in respect of the vehicle

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording relates to motor vehicles other than invalid carriages.
(ii) See section 165(2)(c) for requirements re production of goods vehicle plating certificate and test certificate
(iii) Until 1st November 2021, securities or deposits could be used as an alternative to conventional motor insurance. For offences before that date, see H880.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was

(A)_[the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) when an accident occurred owing its presence]_
(C)_[suspected of committing an offence in relation to the use of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). the defendant failed to give

(D)_[his name and address]_
(E)_[her name and address]_

to a police constable when requested to do so and failed to produce for examination a relevant insurance certificate and a test certificate in respect of the vehicle, when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Gyrrwr cerbyd modur wedi methu â rhoi enw/cyfeiriad/cyflwyno tystysgrif yswiriant/prawf yn dilyn damwain ffordd/trosedd
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(.. SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(.. SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau’n unigolyn

(A)_[a oedd yn gyrru cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[yr oedd gan swyddog heddlu achos rhesymol dros gredu mai chi oedd gyrrwr cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb,]_
(C)_[yr oedd gan swyddog heddlu achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod wedi cyflawni trosedd wrth ddefnyddio cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

ar ffordd, sef, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) ar gais swyddog heddlu, bu ichi fethu â rhoi eich enw a’ch cyfeiriad a chyflwyno y dystysgrif yswiriant berthnasol ar gyfer ei harchwilio o dan Ran VI Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 a thystysgrif prawf a roddwyd ar gyfer y cerbyd
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts:
Am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) roedd y diffynnydd

(A)_[yn yrrwr **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[dan amheuaeth o fod yn yrrwr **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[dan amheuaeth o gyflawni trosedd wrth ddefnyddio **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..).

Methodd y diffynnydd â rhoi

(D)_[ei enw a’i gyfeiriad]_
(E)_[ei henw a’i chyfeiriad]_

i swyddog heddlu pan ofynnwyd iddo/i wneud hynny, a methodd â chyflwyno ar gyfer ei harchwilio, dystysgrif yswiriant berthnasol a thystysgrif prawf ar gyfer y cerbyd, pan ofynnwyd iddo/i wneud hynny, naill ai ar y pryd neu cyn pen saith diwrnod.
